name: Negroni
steps: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.

name: Whiskey Sour
steps: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
Garnish with a lemon slice and cherry.

name: Cosmopolitan
steps: Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a flamed lemon twist.

name: Aperol Spritz
steps: Fill a large wine glass with ice.
Top with a splash of soda.

name: Moscow Mule
steps: Fill a copper mule cup with ice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.

name: Gin & Tonic
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Top with tonic water and stir gently.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
steps: Add all spirits, lemon juice, and syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake briefly and pour into a highball glass over ice.
Top with a splash of cola.

name: Piña Colada
steps: Blend all ingredients with crushed ice.
Garnish with pineapple slice and cherry.

name: Tequila Sunrise
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add tequila and orange juice, stir gently.
Slowly pour grenadine to sink to the bottom.

name: Bloody Mary
steps: Build all ingredients in a highball glass over ice.

name: Amaretto Sour
steps: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.

name: Paloma
steps: Salt the rim of a highball glass.
Fill with ice and add tequila and lime juice.

name: Penicillin
steps: Shake Scotch, lemon juice, and honey-ginger syrup with ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.
Float Islay Scotch over the back of a spoon.

name: Espresso Martini
steps: Shake all ingredients vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.

name: Dark & Stormy
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour ginger beer and lime juice.

name: Sazerac
steps: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and discard.
Stir rye, syrup, and bitters with ice.
Express lemon peel over the glass and discard.

name: French 75
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice.
Strain into a chilled champagne flute.

name: Tom Collins
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice.
Strain into a highball glass over ice.

name: Bramble
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice.
Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass.
Drizzle blackberry liqueur over the top.

name: Clover Club
steps: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.

name: Jungle Bird
steps: Strain over ice in a rocks glass.

name: White Russian
steps: Add vodka and coffee liqueur to a rocks glass over ice.
Float cream over the back of a spoon.

name: Black Russian
steps: Add vodka and coffee liqueur to a rocks glass over ice.

name: Singapore Sling
steps: Strain into a highball glass over ice.

name: Mai Tai
steps: Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass.

name: Pisco Sour
steps: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.
Dot with bitters on the foam.

name: Caipirinha
steps: Muddle lime wedges and sugar in a rocks glass.
Add cachaça and fill with crushed ice.

name: Vodka Martini
steps: Add vodka and vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist or olive.

name: Rob Roy
steps: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.

name: Gibson
steps: Stir gin and vermouth with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.

name: Sex on the Beach
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add all ingredients and stir gently.

name: Hurricane
steps: Strain into a hurricane glass over ice.

name: Zombie
steps: Strain into a highball glass over crushed ice.

name: Stinger
steps: Stir cognac and crème de menthe with ice.

name: Southside
steps: Add remaining ingredients and shake with ice.

name: Bellini
steps: Pour peach purée into a chilled flute.

name: Harvey Wallbanger
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.

name: Mint Julep
steps: Gently muddle mint with syrup in a julep cup.
Add bourbon and fill with crushed ice.
Crown with more crushed ice and garnish with mint bouquet.

name: Hugo Spritz
steps: Add ice and mint to a wine glass.
Top with a splash of soda.

name: Boulevardier
steps: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.

name: Old Fashioned
steps: Add syrup and bitters to a rocks glass.

name: Manhattan
steps: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish.

name: Martini
steps: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.

name: Mojito
steps: Gently muddle mint with syrup and lime juice in a highball.
Add rum and crushed ice, top with soda.

name: Margarita
steps: Strain into a chilled, salt-rimmed glass.
